title: Student Contributor Program Applications Are Now Open
gist: A brief Lawfare announcement opening applications for its Student Contributor Program, which lets current students write articles and provide research support at the nexus of national security, law, and policy, with applications due September 14, 2026.

insights.claim: Lawfare's Student Contributor Program lets current students submit articles and provide research support on issues at the nexus of national security, law, and policy.
insights.speaker: Lawfare Blog
insights.so_what: Indicates Lawfare sources part of its national-security content pipeline from students—context for who produces its coverage.
insights.quote: The Lawfare Student Contributor Program allows current students to submit articles and provide research support on issues at the nexus of national security, law, and policy.

insights.claim: The program is open to law students in their second and third years, LLMs, and SJDs (or foreign equivalent), and graduate students in relevant fields will also be considered.
insights.speaker: Lawfare Blog
insights.so_what: Defines eligibility for the program—relevant only to prospective applicants.
insights.quote: The program is open to law students in their second and third years, LLMs, and SJDs (or foreign equivalent).

insights.claim: Applications for the Lawfare Student Contributor Program are due by September 14, 2026.
insights.speaker: Lawfare Blog
insights.so_what: A dated deadline for prospective applicants.
